notes.title: 🔨 Early Access Update: Visual Polish & Bug Fixes 🎨
notes.notes:
This update focuses primarily on visual improvements and critical bug fixes, without introducing new content for now. You can read more about our Early Access "final build" in the detailed patch notes. 📋

✨ Improvements

 🃏 Cards now feature gentle hover animations for smoother interactions
 ✨ Every entity on your farm will softly glow when you hover over them
 🖱️ Structures with outputs now display a helpful mouse icon to indicate interactive elements
 ⌨️ Added keyboard shortcuts to every button on the top-right of the screen for faster navigation


🐛 Bug Fixes

 💧 Fixed water cost calculations when negative modifiers were combined with multipliers
 🦀 Crabs now properly receive buffs from consumed Eggs
 ✝️ Cross item now correctly transforms Wolf and Alpha Wolf into Pastor
 🏗️ Architect of Utopia essence no longer breaks non-Sheep animals
 🥕 Combining two or more Carrots now gives the correct water cost result for animals


Thank you for your continued support during Early Access! 🙏💚 Special thanks to our friends that reported all those bugs: xameip, Rainy, Radoc, Ethron1of7 and mergele.

notes.title: 🎉 The Final Early Access Update – Thank You!
notes.notes:
After two incredible years of Early Access development, this is our final update milestone before version 1.0! From now on, we’ll no longer use numbered versions and will instead refer to this simply as the Early Access build. We're shifting our focus from adding new cards and content to polishing the game for its full release.

This milestone wouldn’t be possible without you, our amazing community. Every suggestion, bug report, and funny screenshot helped shape Terracards into what it is today. We’re beyond grateful for your patience, feedback, and support throughout this journey. Thank you for being part of it. 💛

Stay tuned — our next big step is launching version 1.0 later this year!

🍏 MacOS: Black Screen Fixed (for real this time!)

In the last update, we believed the black screen issue on Mac was related to the GameMaker compiler (YYC vs VM), so we switched to a DRM-free build without Steam achievements.

Turns out the real cause was the refresh rate being changed during startup — and thanks to a dedicated user named Ender, who provided tons of videos and helpful explanations, we were finally able to reproduce and fix it.

Steam achievements are now fully back on Mac! 🎉  
Thank you again, Ender — you saved Mac players everywhere.

🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements


 🩸 Sacrifice animations got a sprite redraw!
 🃏 Self-Defense and Efficient Farming will also change the island sprite so it may give a hint that's already buffed!
 🐔 Chicken in the Corn now works correctly.
 🤓 Nerd Mode no longer stays active on the main menu.
 🍇 Fuel Grapes Essence:
  • No longer block animals from picking Grapes.  
  • Now give the correct buff to Grapes production.
 🐑 Fake Sheep Crash - Fixed a crash when placing multiple Fake Sheep (previously named "Sheep") in the same fence.
 🍫 Chocolate Factory now properly transforms trees into Cocoa Trees.


✨ What’s Next?

While this marks the end of new content for Early Access, we’re not done yet. Future updates including the 1.0 will focus on:

 ❓ In-game quests: Yeah, you read that right!
 💵 Maybe a new resource to work with?! Stay tuned!
 💎 Meta-progression through gems that you may get at the end of a run. Shiny cards are coming!
 👁‍🗨 Visual improvements: bouncy buttons, animations on all the UI.
 👁‍🗨 Sprite improvements: Some cards might pass through a redraw to fit even more the art-style of the game.


We’re committed to making Terracards shine by the time version 1.0 arrives.
Thanks again for walking this path with us. ❤️

notes.title: 🚨 Important! Mac version is getting an achievement reset!
notes.notes:
We’ve made a major change to the Mac version of Terracards in response to the persistent black screen issue many players have reported since release.

To (hopefully) solve this, we’ve rebuilt the Mac version using a different compilation method. Previously, the game used GameMaker’s YYC compiler, but we’ve now switched to the VM build and made the Mac version completely DRM-free (since Steam is not supported in this compilation method).

This change should resolve the black screen issue, but it comes with an unfortunate side effect:
Steam achievements on Mac will no longer work. Instead, achievements will now be stored and tracked locally only.

Because of this, all Mac achievements are being reset in this update.
We know this may be frustrating, but we hope the improved stability—and being able to actually play the game!—makes up for it.

For the curious or technical, you can check out the original bug report I made in the GameMaker forums [MacOS YYC] "Draw" layer is simply black. Only "Draw GUI" layer displays. — it was marked as “Not Planned,” so this is our best workaround for now.

Thanks for your patience and understanding as we do our best to support every platform!

notes.title: 🛠️ Update 1.5.1: A Complete Refactor of the Game’s Algorithms
notes.notes:
⚙️ Revolutionary Effect Calculation System!
We've completely rebuilt the core engine that handles all passives, essences, and character effects from scratch! Our new algorithm eliminates the problematic "layered" calculations that were causing confusion and delivering incorrect results. This robust, real-time monitoring system ensures every interaction works exactly as intended.

The biggest winners from this massive overhaul are the Gnome, Peanut Gnome, and Watery Tree - these fan-favorite entities were notorious for their quirky behavior, but now they'll perform flawlessly every single time!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269859/43da39aeba04f628efc2f55775492ef9a0025e67.gif"]


🔧 Major Fixes & Improvements
 ✅ Effect Calculations Fixed - Our new algorithm always recalculate to ensure the correct values

 🥜 Peanut Fest Fixed - Yeah, I know you like Peanuts...

 🎯 Tutorial Progression - Resolved soft-lock when selecting other characters

 📐 Blueprint Collision Issues - Game no longer crashes when placing objects over Blueprint items

 🐄 Blueprint Fence Logic Improved - Animals can no longer be incorrectly assigned to Blueprint fences


 
🎮 What's next?
 We're pleased to announce that we're on our way on releasing the full version of the game! Terracards is coming out of Early Access and having it's final content update still this year.

Thanks for your patience during this major technical upgrade!

notes.title: Update 1.4.2: A Snowy Celebration! 🎄✨

🎅 Merry Christmas!  
The world of Terracards has been transformed into a winter wonderland! Enjoy the snowy theme across your islands and get into the holiday spirit.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269859/da3da20b81b2c9a42eb0f0c9d4b176f13b16f198.gif

✨ What’s New?  
  
 🎁 New Items: Sweetcane Juice, Magical Juice, Raw Magical Sugar, Magical Sugar, Magical Fruit, Magical Panettone Dough, Magical Panettone, and Magical Cake.
 💧 Introducing a new structure: Water Mixer, bringing fresh utility to your islands.  
 🏆 Added a new achievement: Holiday Loaf. Can you produce enough Panettone to unlock it?

notes.title: ✨ Update 1.4.1: Bug fixes and new islands! 🏝️
notes.notes:
Hey there, Terracards players! We’re back with another exciting update, bringing fresh content, improvements, and bug fixes to make your experience even smoother. Let’s dive into what’s new and improved in this patch!  

🏝 New Islands and Effects!  
This update introduces a touch of transformation—literally! Some changes now affect the look of your islands, and we’ve added even more ways to customize and improve your farm. Read on for all the details!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269859/d5ba3e1c2523efa508025558dad3e8559bb05769.gif

🛠 Bug Fixes  
  
 🖼 Fixed a crash that occurred when loading a corrupted save image.  
 🐾 Fixed a crash caused by removing a structure with animals inside.  
 🃏 Fixed an issue where the Elixir Slime was giving more than five cards.  
  

✨ What’s New?  
  
 🌴 Effect cards that change the resource consumed now also alter the appearance of the island they’re used on.  
 🔍 You can now check the conditions required for specific cards to appear in the Card Reward system.  
 💣 Added a new effect card: Demolition, allowing you to remove everything on an island at once.

We’re so grateful for your continued support and feedback—it’s what helps us make Terracards the best it can be. Keep those fireplaces warm, because winter is coming with even more surprises! ❄

notes.notes:
Hey there, Terracards players! We’re back with another update packed with exciting content, crucial bug fixes, and at long last: ✨ Magic Cards!

✨ Magic Cards Are Here!
You asked, and we delivered! One of the most requested features—the ability to remove things from your island—is now a reality. Introducing magic cards, available after Day 40. But that’s not all! Discover cards that let you change the resources being used and the powerful Magnet, which increases a structure’s range.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44269859/d8fb1db83debf1c2a440fd1317f1cadf2c44346a.gif

🔧 What’s New?

Thank you for playing and supporting Terracards! We truly appreciate it. And don’t forget to stoke your fireplace—our next update is guaranteed to bring a frosty chill! 🥶

notes.title: 📢 Update 1.3.0 is finally out! Enjoy the HUGE update. ✨
notes.notes:
Hey there, we're happy to announce that 1.3 is finally done and out! After months of work (a lot of work) we're releasing it today.

✨ What's New?
The game has been completely rewritten from the ground up (as you may have seen on the previous news)! We're now using GameMaker instead of Godot to improve the stability of the game and also its support to older hardware.

With this change, you can definitely expect smoother gameplay - say goodbye to the late-game lag!

We pointed some changes on the previous post, but let's take a look at those again:

 The beloved nerd-mode is back! 🤓
 Say goodbye to late-game performance issues. 🚀
 A new Discover screen awaits for your read. 👁‍🗨
 The game over screen now shows a lot of cool information! 🔥


🏆 Achievements!
The most requested feature of the game is finally here! You can now get achievements. Not only that, but achievements becomes perks on the game, which can be used to buff your next run and completely change your gameplay!

👤 Characters
You can now choose between four different characters, each one with their unique gameplay-style and different starter hand.

Note that you need to get some achievements before playing with those!

⚙ Modding
It's not a "real thing" yet, but we started working on it. If you browse the local files of Terracards, you may see that we're exposing some files like "plants.json", "animals.json", "structures.json". Feel free to play with those, they're pretty self explanatory.

A fully functional modding API will probably be released on 1.4!

👀 What's next?
Some of you may notice that this updates (unlike previous ones) do not add to much content to the game, instead, we focused on bringing stability, performance and fixing annoying bugs that you guys related to us.

There are some new animals like 🦄 Unicorn, 🐔 Electric Chicken, 🐇 Electric Rabbit but we didn't focus on content at all.

So expect more content on further updates! 🔥

notes.title: 📢 Prepare for the upcoming 1.3.0 update! ✨
notes.notes:
Hey there, it's been a while since our last update, hasn't it? We're excited to share some great news with you: Version 1.3.0 is nearly complete and brings with it huge improvements! 🚀

What's New?
Let's kick things off with the most significant change: the game has been completely rewritten from the ground up. We've made the switch from Godot Engine to GameMaker, which offers greater stability and compatibility with older devices (say goodbye to selecting Vulkan or OpenGL). 🤓🤘

For you, the end user, this means a substantial boost in performance compared to the older version.

In summary: expect smoother gameplay and effects that finally calculate correctly.


 The beloved nerd-mode is back! 🤓
 Say goodbye to late-game performance issues. 🚀
 Enjoy overall UI improvements. 👁‍🗨
 Sneak peek more content on our Discord #roadmap channel. 🕵️‍♂️

notes.title: Update 1.2.8: Performance improvements and a new Card Reward feature! 🏃‍♂️💨
notes.notes:
Card Reward: Features 🃏✨

 Stack your re-rolls: Card Reward's free re-roll now stacks up to a maximum of 3. Free re-rolls will increase if you don't roll your choices.
 A new algorithm will now attempt to provide structures desired by players based on their previous choices. Re-rolling a structure will prevent it from appearing in the next nine turns.


Performance Improvements 🏃‍♂️💨

 Plants, structures, and animals are now cached into the memory. Hopefully, this will improve the game's performance when executing effects like Wheat Expansion and Corrupted Bunny.
 Loading save files will definitely be faster now due to the previous feature! Unfortunately, you WON'T be able to load farms from previous versions.
 We removed that quick "delay" animation on plants, which was causing some stuttering in the late game.


Fixes 🔧

 Watery Tree wasn't watching for plants placed before it. Fixed! 💦
 Fuel Cow wasn't giving the expected amount of fuel, which is one of the causes of the negative fuel terrifying bug. 🐮
 Fixed a bug where Wheat Expansion was causing the game to trigger every passive two times in a row.

notes.title: 🔧 Update 1.2.7: Hotfixes 🔧
notes.notes:
🐞 Fixes

 Essences: Wheat Expansion and Arboreal Bounty were broken since the latest update. Fixed!
 Temporarily removed the preview of resources and production while holding a card.
 Discover: the title of an Item won't overlap with its price anymore!

notes.title: 🎄 Update 1.2.6: Merry Christmas - It's getting cold right here! ✨
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas! 🎄
We changed some sprites to fit the Christmas theme and also added thematic plants and animals. We wish you a merry Christmas (and a happy new year! 🎶).

New Features ✨

 Cold Water! Lakes are now frozen and may allocate some animals inside of it.
 Added new plants, animals, and structures! - A sneak peek: Crow, Penguin, Elf, Turkey, Santa Claws, Santa Reindeer, Gingerbread Man, Christmas Tree, and Sweet Cane
 Added a new "preview-mode" when placing objects on your farm.


Fixes 🔧

 Made the range algorithm of structures better.
 Implemented a new algorithm for restarting the game; it won't crash your game anymore (we hope, at least). If you find anything that isn't being reset to its default, tell us on our Discord! ✨

notes.title: Update 1.2.5: New Tooltips and Smooth Transitions. 🚜✨
notes.notes:
New Features ✨

 Hover over any object on your farm for accurate information! New tooltips implemented.
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/935172903857692722/1183068032038346803/tooltip.gif?ex=6586fcf7&is=657487f7&hm=8034dc3196687880db7145a0ffc9b7445f89220d19e80cff4fb0ed227b74c875&
 Updated engine to Godot Engine 4.2! 🤖


Fixes 🔧

 Font alignment issues in Japanese, Chinese, Korean, etc., fixed!
 Dionisian Rites now work on plants placed during the buff. Fixed!
 Loading game crashes resolved!
 Scene transitions now fade in/out, eliminating black bars on non-16:9 monitors.

notes.title: Update 1.2.4: Bug fixes and QoL features! 👨‍🌾
notes.notes:
Features ✨

 Avoid accidental island purchases! Expansion areas now display an animation before confirming.
 Re-roll cost nerfed: Calculation was incorrect—apologies for the confusion.
 Toggle nerd-mode with TAB (Alt-key removed due to incompatibilities).
 Discover item tab: you can now click on structure names to navigate to their page.


Fixes 🔧

 Island expansion areas now work correctly after loading a game.
 Islands now correctly calculate their neighbors after loading a save. Issue resolved!
 Plants, structures, and animals now perform their effects correctly after loading a save. (We expect at least! 😅)

notes.title: 1.2.3 Update: Expand with ease! 🏝️ Reworked re-rolls and bug fixes
notes.notes:
New Features ✨

 Expand your island without pressing any button. Just hover over it!
 Card Reward re-roll has been refactored; it will cost way more gold to re-roll, but won't show repeated or its last cards.
 Are you lost? A new warning will show up on your screen if you are too far from your islands.
 Discover is now displayed in fullscreen.


Fixes 🔧

 Giant Sunflower now produces the correct amount.
 Energy Spring essence now works on Water Chickens.
 Solar Panel now won't transform sunflowers on their own island, just adjacent ones.
 Animals that don't output anything were crashing the game. Fixed!

notes.title: Update 1.2.2: Balancing Acts and Bug Squashes! ✨
notes.notes:
Fixes 🔧

 Effects based on production (Water Chicken, Gnomes, Peanut Gnomes) weren't working correctly. This has been addressed.
 Multipliers now properly accumulate before applying to the result. Previously, three effects of 2x production would yield 6x instead of 8x. This unintended behavior has been fixed!
 Structures' range broke in the latest update due to the implementation of cache to prevent lag. This issue has been resolved.
 The Hatchery will now respect its limits and only request 5 or fewer items of a pack, preventing it from pulling all items.


Balancing 📈

 Sunflower: Do not place structures on their island; they will now detect it!
 Corn: It's only buffed with +10 production if there are 16 corns on neighboring islands.
 Tropical Soil: Now provides +12 gold value instead of +2.

notes.title: Update 1.2.1 - Small hotfixes!
notes.notes:
Fixes 🔧

 Watery Tree calculations were completely inaccurate and have been corrected.
 Effects that disable resource costs are now functioning correctly.
 Taxes weren't being stored in the save data! This issue has been fixed.
 The Miracle was prematurely killing all plants before they could use water. This issue has been resolved.

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 - 💾 Autosave! New effects, structures and items ✨
notes.notes:
Disclaimer 🙇‍♂️
We planned to add achievements to the game on this release, but due to a lot of solved bugs and the new content, we've changed our plans to implement it in the future. For updates on achievements, stay tuned for future announcements!

New Features! ✨

 Autosave: Your progress is now automatically saved, allowing you to continue from where you left off in your latest gameplay! 💾
 Corn: +10 production per adjacent island with only Corns. More Corns, more production! 🌽
 Sugarcane: it makes some stuff. You should open the game to read it!
 New structures: Water Tank, Transport Tube and Poop Collector.
 New items: Mayonnaise, Cookie Dough, Chocolate Cookie Dough, Cookie, Chocolate Cookie, Pie Crust, Apple Pie, Tortilla.


Fixes 🔧

 Order of effect execution: we're 90% sure that we've fixed this. Now we need your feedback!
 Pastor now increases Sheep production.
 Fuel Corn was totally broken when you had a nearby Melter.
 Rabbit Apprentice didn't work on 🐔 Chickens.
 Fisherman's Hut didn't calculate it's values correctly.

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 - Small fixes 🔧
notes.notes:
Fixes 🔧

 Sunflower effect has been changed.
 Giant Carrot effect has been buffed.
 Fuel Grapes essence has been nerfed.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3 - Fixed Card Reward algorithm! 🔧
notes.notes:
Fixes 🔧

 Fixed Card Reward algorithm. It was actually impossible to find Mixer and Oven!
 Drunk Chickens and Slimes won't give an unlimited number of cards, capped on 5 cards per turn.
 Essence: Bunny Like Carrot was giving buffs to carrots and not to bunnies. Fixed!

notes.title: Update 1.1.2 - QoL and Lag caused by structures combos fixed! 🔧
notes.notes:
There was a HUGE HUGE bug related to structure combos that caused the game to freeze for about 4 seconds in the late game. We implemented optimizations in the code to address this, and we believe the lag issue has been resolved!

Features ✨

 Finishing a day with zero gold does not end the game!
 You can now toggle Card Reward visibility to take a look at your farm.
 Biofuel Generator now shows its fuel production in Nerd Mode.
 Balancing: Reroll prices are now halved whenever you pick up a card.
 Balancing: Home Sweet Home has been nerfed to 2x instead of 3x.


Fixes 🔧

 Welcome back OpenGL! Users who can't run Vulkan can now select OpenGL when starting their game on Steam.
 Items affected by Peanut Gnome didn't send their items to machines around. This issue has been resolved!
 Peanuts produced by Peanut Cow weren't being used by machines around. This issue has been resolved!
 You can't place things on your farm if any interface that overlays the game is visible anymore.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.1 - Huge rendering changes!
notes.notes:
Goodbye OpenGL! 👋
Some players reported us a black-screen right at the start of the game. This is caused because some high-end machines do not support old versions of OpenGL, which is the rendering back-end we were using. So we decided to bump up the rendering back-end to Vulkan, which is a newer, better and more performant rendering API.

But this also means that now older machines will not support the game anymore. If you're one of those, please send us a message on our Discord and we'll make available for you an version of the game using OpenGL.

Fixes 🔧

 Items being created on random positions after the latest update are now fixed!
 Black-screen bug is gone!
 Replaced OpenGL with Vulkan

notes.title: Update 1.1.0🔧 ✨
notes.notes:
Fixes 🔧

 Fixed the lag spikes when too much items were created at the same time
 Fixed crashes when pressing the RESTART button on game over
 Essence "Bunny Apprentices" didn't work correctly
 Essence "Cow Deluge" wasn't changing it's cost with "Black Water"
 Female Rabbit won't give a card of itself
 Biofuel Genrator didn't work properly. Fixed!


Additions ✨

 Visual representation of legendary cards!
 Visual representation of combos that gives cards as their output
 Structures range now works in a circular form instead of cross

notes.title: 🎉 DEMO UPDATE! 1.0.0 🎉
notes.notes:
Hey! We've finally achieved a stable version of the game and we expect that this version brings with it the fix of almost all bugs found during this early demo stage.

Features ✨

 Added new languages: Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Polish


Fixes 🔧

 Card Reward: You won't be able to roll without money anymore. This caused a lot of issues!
 Animals: crabs won't produce for each eaten egg anymore.

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
The purpose of this update is to just bring more stability to the game. We didn't add new content to the demo. We're focusing on making all the content of the full version! ✨

What's new?

 Added new languages: Italiano, Español, Deutsch and Français
 Added Cocoa Tree back into the game


Fixes

 Animals: Crabs weren't eating their food from Fisherman's Hut.
 Essence: Hmm, Popcorn wasn't working. Fixed!
 Essence: Veganism was completely broken, was giving 10x instead of the described 3x!

notes.title: 🔧 Hotfix 0.3.2
notes.notes:
The increase on taxes has caused a lot of headaches all around the world! 🧠

🔧 Fixes

 Decreased the HUGE increase on taxes cost: the game was too hard (Sorry about that 😅)
 Improved descriptions readability: increased space between multiple effects

notes.title: ✨ Demo Update 0.3.0: New content and features!
notes.notes:
First we wanna thanks all of our Discord members that are hugely helping us through the development of Terracards.

New features! ✨

 HUGE INCREASE ON TAXES! The game was simply too easy... 😊
 Card Reward will only show structures that you may use for something
 ZOOM! Yeah, you've asked on our Discord for that and we heard you. Enjoy
 Antenna has been changed. Won't change the water/fuel cost of objects on adjacent islands anymore
 Inventory / Market has been completely changed. There's no more "inventory"
 New plants: electric carrot and giant carrot 🌱
 New animals: sheep, electric sheep and rabbit 🐑
 New items: wool, electric wool and rabbit foot 🧶
 You can now see when the next taxes is coming below your gold 💸


Fixes 🔧

 Z-index of cards: when you hover them they will show above others to make it easier to read
 Fuel Grapes essence was giving it's buff to every plant (which is definitely not intended) 


Known Bugs 🐞

 Preview of resources may not work as expected (water chicken and electric carrot + rabbit may cause some issues)
 Windows 11: some users are reporting a black screen on the start of the game. We're still investigating it. For now, please try using compatibility mode

notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update 0.2.1
notes.notes:
🔼 Things improved since first demo version

 Structures: before placing down a structure, you can now see it's range
 Camera can now be moved by touching the bounds of the game's screen
 Overlays now closes with the Escape key
 Card Reward has more chance of giving you Small Fences or Medium Fences when you have animals on your deck
 New icon for "Plant" and "Plants"


✨ New features!

 Nerd mode implemented! Activate it on settings to see advanced information on each plant, animal and structure
 Deck interface: you can now visualize the cards that you have on your hand and cards that you've already seen
 Right click on bottom cards opens the Discover with their data


🔧 Fixes

 Bird Nest: won't create more than 5 cards of each animal per turn
 Essence - Going Wide: won't give you more than 5 cards per turn
 When transformed, animals with different sizes didn't gave the correct credit of slots on their structures
 Passing two turns fast won't give you more cards anymore
